journey.name: transfer through primary
journey.description: Proves transfers move funds between savings and the primary channel without closing it, and that an on-chain send larger than savings is paid from the channel. Precondition: see README.md; a wallet with a channel with the primary.

actions.action: Open Spending and tap Transfer To Savings, then confirm the transfer
Verify the transfer completes, Settings › Advanced › Lightning connections still lists the channel, and the savings balance grew
Open Settings › Advanced › Primary node and verify "PrimaryNodeFundingPaused" is shown
Mine a block, open Savings and tap Transfer To Spending
Verify the "PrimaryTransfer" screen shows the amount and "PrimaryTransferFee", then tap "PrimaryTransferConfirm"
Verify the "Transfer started" toast, and after a block that the spending balance grew and "PrimaryNodeFundingPaused" is gone
Send on-chain to the second wallet an amount above the savings balance and below the spending balance
Verify the send completes and the spending balance fell by the amount plus fee
